chunks: What al-Shaykh — may Allah the Exalted support him — informed me of, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Safwan, from Aban ibn 'Uthman, from 'Abd al-Malik ibn 'Amr, who said:

I asked Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام about a man who had intercourse with his slave-girl while she was menstruating. He said: “He should seek forgiveness from his Lord.” 'Abd al-Malik said: The people say that half a dinar or a dinar is due upon him. So Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام said: “Then let him give charity to ten needy persons.”

This is to be understood as referring to when the intercourse occurred at the end of menstruation, because if it had been at its beginning or middle, he would not have departed from the expiation of a dinar or half a dinar, according to what we mentioned previously. Since it was at the end of menstruation, and he considered what expiation was binding upon him, it is preferable that he distribute it among ten needy persons; thus he instructed him to do that. This is what reconciles all the details we have mentioned before.

key_terms.دِينَارٌ: a dinar mentioned as a form of expiation
key_terms.طَامِثٌ: menstruating; in a state of hayd
key_terms.مَسَاكِينِ: needy persons who are to receive the charity
key_terms.نِصْفُ دِينَارٍ: half a dinar mentioned as a form of expiation
key_terms.يَسْتَغْفِرُ: he seeks forgiveness from Allah for the act

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Tahdhib al-Ahkam on intercourse during menstruation and its expiation?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling concerning intercourse with a menstruating slave-girl, stating first that the person should seek forgiveness from Allah. It then mentions giving charity to ten needy persons, and the compiler explains that this is understood as applying to intercourse near the end of menstruation, reconciling it with other reports mentioning a dinar or half a dinar as expiation.
